During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] '''buyer''' considered purchasing a creature known as a [[Bursa/Legends|bursa]] from an [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] [[Unidentified Amaran bursa dealer|dealer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Pacithhip was considering reselling the beast to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. As the two parties negotiated, the Pacithhip held her [[Unidentified Pacithhip child|child]] on her back.
